name: claude-permission-flash
description: Flashes the VS Code chrome (title bar / status bar / activity bar) when Claude Code is waiting on a permission prompt.

commands.title: Claude Permission Flash: Test Done Flash
Claude Permission Flash: Acknowledge (Stop Flash for This Window)
Claude Permission Flash: Clear All Active Flags
Claude Permission Flash: Reset Baseline Colors to Current

claudePermissionFlash.flagDirectory.description: Directory watched for permission-prompt flag files, written by the Claude Code hook.

claudePermissionFlash.activeColor.description: Background color applied to title bar, status bar, and activity bar while a permission prompt is pending.

claudePermissionFlash.textColor.description: Foreground/text color used on top of the active color.

claudePermissionFlash.tintEditorTabs.description: Also tint the editor tab bar, for a more attention-grabbing (but more intrusive) effect.

claudePermissionFlash.doneColor.description: Background color used for the short 'task done' pulse, fired when a turn runs long enough to count as a task rather than a quick reply. Deliberately different from activeColor so the two are never confused at a glance.

claudePermissionFlash.doneTextColor.description: Foreground/text color used on top of doneColor.
